autoscaling_policy_preferences: Warm pool: maintain 2 always-on warm nodes per pool to reduce cold starts
Predictive scaling: use historical hourly patterns to pre-warm additional nodes before known traffic windows
Reactive triggers: scale-up when GPU util > 70% for 30s OR queue length > 50 requests
Scale-up granularity: add 1-2 nodes at a time during normal hours, larger ramp for scheduled events
Scale-down: start after 10m stable underutilization; cool-down 15m during peak windows
Fallback: automatic route to smaller quantized model variant if capacity pressure detected
queueing_and_backpressure: Priority queues: interactive chat highest, reranking medium, nightly batch lowest
Admission control: reject low-priority batch during sustained overload, return backpressure signals to upstream
Fairness: token-based scheduling with route weights to preserve SLA for paying routes
Metrics: track queue length, head-of-line wait, average wait per route for alerts and autoscale decisions
